finding.comment: The test job's reusable workflow is demoted to a mutable branch while lint stays pinned; a push to shared-ci main runs arbitrary test-side code with CODECOV_TOKEN access — the supply-chain pin is inconsistently undone.

files.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -6,10 +6,10 @@
 jobs:
   lint:
     uses: acme/shared-ci/.github/workflows/lint.yml@d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d
   test:
-    uses: acme/shared-ci/.github/workflows/test.yml@e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e
+    uses: acme/shared-ci/.github/workflows/test.yml@main
     secrets:
       CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

rationale: same diff, comment and vocabulary; only the added ref differs: demotion to @main vs re-pin to a new immutable SHA. 18C amendment: all refs are now genuine 40-hex commit SHAs (18B pair was INVALID: 39/41-hex runs).
